question: Please help me find the names of top 5 players with the highest average runs per match in season 5, along with their batting averages.
sql:
WITH player_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.striker as player_id,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_runs,
        COUNT(*) as balls_faced
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
        AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE bb.match_id IN (SELECT match_id FROM match WHERE season_id = 5)
        AND bb.striker IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.striker
),
player_matches AS (
    SELECT 
        pm.player_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT pm.match_id) as matches_played
    FROM player_match pm
    WHERE pm.match_id IN (SELECT match_id FROM match WHERE season_id = 5)
    GROUP BY pm.player_id
)
SELECT 
    pr.player_id,
    p.player_name,
    pr.total_runs,
    pr.balls_faced,
    ROUND(pr.total_runs / NULLIF(pm.matches_played, 0), 2) as avg_runs_per_match,
    ROUND(pr.total_runs / NULLIF(pr.balls_faced, 0), 2) as batting_average
FROM player_runs pr
JOIN player_matches pm ON pr.player_id = pm.player_id
JOIN player p ON pr.player_id = p.player_id
ORDER BY avg_runs_per_match DESC
LIMIT 5
